feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. The candidate is the iteration 10 design (base_speed 1.7, kp 3.0, ki 1.0, kd 0.5, outer sensors at x = ±0.04, sensor_size 0.016, last_direction). It is the best raced design so far at 299.69, up from 216.97 in iterations 7 and 9. The gain came from base_speed: oval finishes rose from 4/20 to 14/20, with mean oval finish time 1.90 s and oval progress 0.91. The candidate is valid and inside every contract limit. Its one open weakness is the bends: s-bend progress fell from 0.462 (1.6) to 0.264 at 1.7, and all 20 s-bend runs went off track. Slalom progress also fell slightly (0.124 to 0.102). Those regressions were already in the iteration 10 race data, so they are known and do not change the decision. Further revision would need a race to check, and this is the final iteration with no later race to confirm a change. The rational choice is to race the best known design unchanged. Approve. The requested changes below are watch items for the record and are not to be applied in this run.
requested_changes: Keep base_speed at 1.7. Do not raise it to 1.8 without fresh evidence, because s-bend progress already dropped from 0.462 to 0.264 when base_speed went from 1.6 to 1.7 (iteration 10).
Keep kp 3.0, ki 1.0, kd 0.5 and sensor_size 0.016. Iterations 4, 5 and 8 each lowered the score when these moved, and iteration 10 is the best tested combination.
For the unseen final track, bend-heavy courses are the main risk. Track bend progress and max_error, since s-bend results at 1.7 show the design can leave the line on tight curves.
